title: Model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama/Mistral/Qwen (GQA/MQA tuning, kernels, KV cache, continuous batching)
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Several model backends (Llama-family, Mistral, Qwen) expose subtle attention, rotary, and kv-cache access patterns that defeat the generic kernel/scheduler heuristics in the runtime. This PR adds targeted model-specific heuristics and safe fast-paths to recover throughput and reduce per-token latency while preserving numerical correctness across GQA/MQA quantized variants. Summary of changes: 1) Kernel selection heuristics: introduce a model fingerprint stage at model load that sets preferred GEMM kernels and attention loop order for known quirks (Llama: fused Q/K for sliced kv shapes; Mistral: grouped rotary stride; Qwen: multi-head layout optimizations). 2) GQA/MQA tuning: add quantization-aware kernel variants and dynamic scale fusion to avoid extra dequant/requant for common dtypes; special-case 8-bit GQA via a single fused matmul+scale kernel. 3) KV cache improvements: compact KV storage layout for models with asymmetric cache growth, lazy allocation of shard buffers, and an eviction-resistant prefix cache for short-lived conversational workloads. 4) Continuous batching scheduler: change the batching policy so that small latency-sensitive requests get prefetched into short-lived micro-batches; add an admission scorer that uses model fingerprint + request seq-length histogram to pick per-request batching mode. 5) Tests and tooling: add model fingerprint unit tests, end-to-end perf bench harness updates, and integration tests against Qwen-2 and Mistral-7B. Performance: internal bench on a 8xA100 cluster for common chat workload shows 18-28% throughput improvement and 10-17% median latency reduction at p95 compared to baseline for the affected models. Safety & compatibility: all model-specific paths are opt-in per model metadata and guarded by runtime flags to allow staged rollouts. Notes on rollout: feature gated behind runtime flags, default enabled on dedicated pool after staged canary run. Checklist: [x] unit tests updated [x] integration + perf harness updated [x] documented fingerprint config [x] feature-gated rollout plan
